newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Wesfarmers sees higher annual profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Wesfarmers sees higher annual profit.

text.p: Diversified industrial firm Wesfarmers Ltd said on Tuesday that profits in 1996/97 would rebound from 1995/96 but would be below the 65 percent growth seen in the first quarter of this year.

"Unfortunately it won't be that high for the full year, but we are looking for a bit of a rebound from the 1995/96 full year and increasing profits beyond that," chief executive Michael Chaney told a Securities Institute of Australia briefing
Chaney also said Perth-based Wesfarmers saw similar real growth in earnings before interest and tax over the next four to five years as that experienced between 1991 and 1996.
He said Wesfarmers was relaxed about the 25 percent drop in profit in the 1995/96 year, which was due to a downturn in the housing and farming sectors.
The company had been promoting itself in recent months as a company which would rebound in the same way it did after the 1991 recession.
